images.caption: Brick ranch-style house near Homestead Park in Rochester, Minnesota

place.source_title: Brick ranch-style house near Homestead Park

brief: Typical mid-century brick ranch: one storey under a low hipped asphalt roof with a centre chimney, red-orange brick walls with a small decorative block panel, a large picture window, a recessed entrance and an attached one-car garage facing a concrete drive, foundation shrubs and a big shade tree.

facade.notes: a 1960 red-brick hipped ranch: a big picture window, a one-car garage door flush with the front, glass-block strip windows in the garage wall and bathroom, a stone-capped chimney, a satellite dish; foundation evergreens; a broad concrete driveway

why.note: the 1960 small ranch: hip roof, brick, the garage as part of the facade
the picture window: the postwar living room's view of the lawn
